recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not make a FHIR-5489 source edit unless a new work-group decision identifies a specific missing current Bundle example, such as a concrete history-bundle example or a negotiated entry.link usage.
issue_request: FHIR-5489 was a Published/Persuasive Jan 2015 FHIR-I ballot comment against FHIR-core Feed asking for examples showing how child attributes of Bundle entry are used. The approval note says the continuous build was approved as edited/currently published on 2015-02-12.
initial_application: No historical commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5489 was found. The issue appears to have been applied in the continuous build through nearby Bundle documentation work: commit 368c9c3074eeb60fb30efdb8d319e75345501ebc rewrote the Bundle example as a commented searchset and added Bundle notes with type-specific example links, and commit f5a4865af08cdd1cd46e513340a9c7338b8b4d17 added transaction and transaction-response Bundle examples and linked them from the Bundle notes before the Jira approval as edited/currently published.
additional_context: Bundle remains active in source/fhir.ini, so source/bundle is current build scope. Current Bundle notes explain entry usage by Bundle type and link examples for document, message, searchset, transaction/batch, transaction/batch response, collection, and subscription-notification contexts. The active examples list includes search, transaction, transaction-response, batch request/response, complex transaction request/response, and reference-resolution examples. The current StructureDefinition defines the entry children and states that Bundle.entry.link has no FHIR-defined function beyond implementation-specific context, so a dedicated entry.link example is not required to avoid conformance ambiguity. Community searches found no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence record changing this conclusion.
reconciliation: Made no source change. The current spec already conveys the requested guidance through active source definitions, Bundle notes, and examples; adding another example for this old DSTU1 ballot item would be redundant rather than a necessary current-spec fix.
